body: FFY 2026 ARKANSAS LIHEAP ELIGIBILITY CHART ADD $688 FOR EACH ADDITIONAL HOUSEHOLD MEMBER Additional Eligibility Criteria: If utilities are included in your rent, you must provide a lease agreement. Your lease agreement is required to demonstrate an energy burden. Energy burden criteria are different for subsidized housing than unsubsidized housing. HOUSEHOLD SIZE INCOME LIMIT DETERMINED BY: MAXIMUM MONTHLY COUNTABLE INCOME (MCI) 1 State Median Income (SMI) $2,347 2 SMI $3,070 3 SMI $3,792 4 SMI $4,514 5 SMI $5,236 6 SMI $5,958 7 SMI $6,094 8 Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) $6,769 9 FPG $7,456 10 FPG $8,144 11 FPG $8,831 12 FPG $9,519 13 FPG $10,206 14 FPG $10,894 15 FPG $11,581 16 FPG $12,269 17 FPG $12,956 18 FPG $13,644 19 FPG $14,331 20 FPG $15,019
